caption: The drawing depicts a scenic riverside landscape featuring several distinct elements. In the foreground, there are rocky cliffs and large trees with green foliage and brown trunks. At the lower center, a group of people dressed in vivid red and blue clothing are seated in a blue boat on the river, with several long oars extending from the boat. Additional figures can be seen on the rocky shore and in a smaller boat nearby. To the right, there is a multi-story stone building with classical architectural features, including rectangular windows and columns. The river, rendered in shades of blue, flows through the center of the scene and is crossed by a large arched stone bridge in the distance. Beyond the bridge, a city with numerous buildings, spires, and towers extends across the horizon. The background contains pale mountains and a sky that transitions from blue at the top to soft peach near the horizon. The entire composition is framed on the left and upper edges by trees and rocky terrain, with the lower right portion of the image fading into blank space.
